task:
A Shotcut project exists at /home/user/Documents/my_project.mlt with 1920x1080 resolution and 30 fps. Two video files exist: clip_a.mp4 and clip_b.mp4 in /home/user/Videos/.

Actions required:
1. Add clip_a.mp4 to the project.
2. Add clip_b.mp4 to the project.
3. Place both clips on the V1 timeline track sequentially, with clip_a.mp4 first followed immediately by clip_b.mp4.
4. Save the project.

The saved my_project.mlt must maintain the 1920x1080 30 fps profile and reference both clip_a.mp4 and clip_b.mp4 on the same track.

verification.description: Clip clip_a.mp4 is referenced in the project
Clip clip_b.mp4 is referenced in the project

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CLI: project open my_project.mlt, timeline add-clip clip_a.mp4 --track 1, timeline add-clip clip_b.mp4 --track 1, project save
cli_feasibility.reason: ✅ Fully supported by CLI-Anything shotcut skills: project open, timeline add-clip (multiple calls), project save. Sequential clip placement on single track.
